Check out this versatile mini PC packed into a case about the size of an Apple Mac Mini. Amazon is currently offering Amazon Prime members the Acemagic M1 AMD Ryzen 7 7735HS Mini PC with 24GB of RAM and a 512GB SSD for just $426.29 with free shipping after applying coupon code " CH5QALWQ ". This is a rare mini PC deal that comes with a generous amount of coveted flash memory and storage; most of the deals nowadays are for barebone models.

Acemagic M1 AMD Ryzen 7 7735HS Complete Mini PC for $426.29

Includes 24GB of LPDDR5 RAM, 512GB SSD, and Windows 11

The Acemagic M1 measures 5" x 5" x 1.6", roughly the same size as a Mac Mini. It features an AMD Ryzen 7 7735HS 8-core CPU with a max turbo frequency of 4.7GHz and Radeon 680M onboard graphics, 24GB of soldered LPDDR5-5500MHz RAM and a 512GB M.2 SSD. Windows 11 Pro OS is pre-installed.

The Ryzen 7 77535HS chip is equipped with onboard Radeon 680M graphics. As far as low-power onboard graphic solutions go, the 680M is an excellent gaming chip. In the past, iGPU gaming performance was just a meme, but not so anymore. The 680M is capable of running games like Fortnite and Minecraft at 1080p, and even more demanding games like Red Dead Redemption 2, Apex Legends, or even Cyberpunk with heavily modified settings.

There are plenty of connectivity options here. Running down the list we have six USB 3 Type-A ports, one USB 3 Type-C port, four USB 3 Type-A ports, one HDMI port, one DisplayPort, one 3.5mm audio jack, and one 2.5Gbe ethernet jack. It's also equipped with Bluetooth 5.2 and WiFi 6 wireless networking.

This micro-sized PC works great as a Windows box that can be used for productivity tasks, web browsing, video streaming, and even some light gaming. Attach some local storage to it and it can be used as a home server or a security NVR. It's small enough to tuck away inconspicuously, like affixed to the back of your monitor.
